about: r15 skillfx: per-skill cast look. pose = hero action (poses table; baked anims live in assets/heroes/*/<look>/<anim>.webp, missing ones fall back to the strike swing). pal = colour family (palettes). shapes = what is drawn on cast (kinds: slash cleave thrust spin nova zapring ripple shout sigil scorch cloud glyph plant fan cone streak link bolt meteor pillar dome swirl veil burst flash). at = hero|aim|ahead|start|path|friends|traps|arc|ring. impact = sparks on hits that came from this skill. proj = projectile skin. ready = when to light the skill button (and a matching ring on the hero). auras = look on the hero while that buff runs; the buff row by the life orb shows icon and seconds. telegraph = enemy wind-up cues. js/ab-skillfx.js draws it; nothing here changes damage.

spin.about: one full turn with the blade out

slam.about: weapon high overhead, then down into the ground (baked Jump_Land)

raise.about: big rise and slam for ultimates

channel.about: held cast while a ward or circle forms

plant.about: kneel and set something in the ground (baked Farm_PlantSeed)

buffRow.about: Icons above the life and mana orbs for every timed buff that has an aura or a skill entry here.

telegraph.about: Enemy wind-ups. eliteWarn: elites, champions, minibosses and bosses also telegraph hits above eliteWarnPct of your life (normal foes keep the 20% rule). leapWindup/chargeWindup: seconds a leaper or charger stands and shows an arrow before it jumps.
